home.summary: The Buffalo Sabres are returning to their home ice for the 2026-27 season, with Colten Ellis confirmed to start in goal. Key players like Jiri Kulich, Rasmus Dahlin, Tage Thompson, and Noah Östlund are returning to the lineup. The team is looking to build on their strong fan support and positive momentum from the previous season.
